content.text: PyTorch 2.6 默认 `weights_only=True`，需要设置为 False。

source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/meta_brain_lora_routing && python3 -c "
import torch
ckpt = torch.load('/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/par_router_real_env_multilayer_v2/best_router.pt', map_location='cpu', weights_only=False)
print('Keys:', list(ckpt.keys()))
for k, v in ckpt.items():
    if not isinstance(v, torch.Tensor):
        print(f'{k}: {v}')
"
